name: safedrop-code
description: Convenience runner for the SafeDrop backend and frontend outside Docker. CI and Docker use the packages directly.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
